newsitem.title: UK: Property group Ashtenne plans summer market float.
newsitem.headline: Property group Ashtenne plans summer market float.

text.p: Industrial property specialist Ashtenne Holdings Plc said on Monday it was planning an 80 million stg flotation on the London Stock Exchange this summer.
The company, which specialises in the acquisition and active management of industrial property estates and portfolios, said it would be looking to raise up to 20 milion stg of new money.
The float would be used to raise the company's profile and allow it access to a wider capital market, Ashtenne said.
For the year ended December 31 1996, Ashtenne had a gross rental income of 11.7 million stg and made pre-tax profits of 4.0 million stg.
Ashtenne has appointed NatWest Markets and Cazenove & Co as sponsors and brokers respectively, and the pathfinder prospectus is expected to be published in mid-June.
